keyPoints.en: Skim for gist, scan for details.
keyPoints.bm: Baca luncuran untuk idea umum, imbasan untuk butiran.

keyPoints.en: The topic sentence (often first) holds the main idea; the rest supports it.
keyPoints.bm: Ayat topik (selalunya pertama) memegang idea utama; selebihnya menyokong.

keyPoints.en: Underline question keywords; search for synonyms in the text.
keyPoints.bm: Gariskan kata kunci soalan; cari sinonim dalam teks.

keyPoints.en: Inference: use clues (actions, feelings, contrast words) to work out unstated meaning.
keyPoints.bm: Inferens: gunakan petunjuk (tindakan, perasaan, kata pertentangan) untuk memahami makna tersirat.

keyPoints.en: Reference: look back for the nearest suitable noun; test by substituting.
keyPoints.bm: Rujukan: lihat kembali kata nama yang sesuai paling hampir; uji dengan menggantikannya.

tip.en: Substitution test: replace "it" with your answer — does the sentence still make sense?
tip.bm: Ujian gantian: gantikan "it" dengan jawapan anda — adakah ayat masih bermakna?

keyPoints.en: Guess word meanings from context: definitions, examples, contrasts nearby.
keyPoints.bm: Teka makna perkataan daripada konteks: definisi, contoh, pertentangan berdekatan.
Tujuan: memberi maklumat, memujuk, menghibur, menasihati.

keyPoints.en: Tone is shown by word choice: critical, humorous, sarcastic, hopeful.
keyPoints.bm: Nada ditunjukkan melalui pilihan kata: kritis, lucu, menyindir, penuh harapan.
